Expansion adds Mars terrain, dimension and linked planet record.
Gas giant, ice world and base Mars are astronomical planet records, not linked surface dimensions.
sources: Base data/rocketnautics/universe_planets/gas_giant.json, ice_world.json and mars.json contain no dimension_data

release_evidence.claim: Space Helmet requires pressurized air. Jetpack supplies it while consuming fuel.
Deep Air requires a sealed, unbreached compartment with Oxygen Diffuser fluid and redstone for breathing. Gravity separately requires powered, signaled Gravity Generator in a Sable sublevel.
Hologram Table and Sputnik are registered items with selected-release recipes and descriptions.

limitations: No game or server was launched. Actual transfer, landing, passengers, item preservation, saved ships, breathing, gravity and compatibility remain unverified.
No dedicated station construction, docking or station persistence mechanism was evidenced in selected release artifacts. Generic Sable ship support does not establish a station mechanic.
Deep Air 1.0.2 declares optional mod identifier cosmonautics, while the selected base mod id is rocketnautics. Keep this discrepancy for runtime testing.
Expansion provider page declares All Rights Reserved. Redistribution permission is not established.
Gas giant and ice world are not called landable. No Northstar, Warp Drive, development-only Abyss or planned placeholder is included.

No generated tutorial images were added. Selected GuideME parser and structural compiler passed. Structural probe normalizes item identifiers to vanilla and does not compile Recipe or KeyBind. Live registries, actual rendering and export bytes remain unverified.

integration_review.scope: Authoritative bilingual sources, generator, provider purposes, namespace queries, primary associations and generated resource pages. No gameplay artifacts, configuration, export or runtime changed.
corrections: Rocket Thruster is fuel driven. Removed invented Create rotation requirement after inspecting RocketThrusterBlockEntity and RocketPonderScenes.
Gravity detection independently requires a sealed uncompromised room and active generator, not an oxygen supply. LifeSupportStatus caches oxygen and gravity separately.
Removed inactive Abyss from player destination catalog. Preserved development-only dimension evidence here.
Removed author testing and selected-release commentary from player copy. Kept celestial display and dimension boundaries.
AeroEngine fuel compat selected binary description specifies The Factory Must Grow kerosene. Provider row uses related producer queries, not its itemless addon namespace.
integration_review.reviewed_artifact_hashes: Recomputed and matched all four Cosmonautics and Deep Seas SHA512 metadata hashes in native packwiz cache.
integration_review.runtime_boundary: Transfer, passenger and inventory preservation, approach, landing, breathing, gravity, saved ships and compatibility remain unverified. No client or server launch authorized.

helmet_acquisition.craftable_alternative: Create 6.0.10 DivingHelmetItem.breatheUnderwater accepts a cannot-breathe event with worn DivingHelmetItem and BacktankUtil air, without a water-only check. Cosmonautics sets cannot breathe at HIGHEST event priority. Copper Diving Helmet and Copper Backtank shaped crafting recipes exist. Runtime remains unverified.

recipe_renderer_boundary.reason: GuideME RecipeTypeMapping.tryCreate matches recipe type identity, not ShapedRecipe inheritance. Selected GuideME has vanilla mappings and selected Create and Cosmonautics contain no GuideME mapping provider. Mechanical crafting now uses recipe-browser guidance.

integration_review.ponder_localization: RocketPonderScenes uses text_1 through text_6 keys that are absent from packaged locale JSON. Native scene registration is verified, readable lesson text remains unresolved.
integration_review.mars_merge: Expansion packages equal-priority mars and mars_planet definitions with conflicting radius and texture. Linked dimension can survive merge but effective orbital geometry depends on order. No tested approach or landing claim.
